text: In September 2014, twenty-six of us said "train and equip," and twenty-five said "to train and equip," each peaking on the seventeenth. Twenty-three of us said "the middle east" that same day. On the eleventh, twenty-one of us marked "13th anniversary of," and nineteen said "the 13th anniversary of." Toward the month's end, on the twenty-ninth, nineteen of us said "community college and," eighteen said "assistance community college and career training," and eighteen said "trade adjustment assistance." Three subjects, three peak days: the seventeenth, the eleventh, the twenty-ninth. We converged first on what to do abroad, then on a date to observe, then on a program at home. We record that "train and equip" first appeared in our ledger before this month, and that we returned to it together here.
